subject.title: feat: retain iMessage tombstones and revisions

question: Should ordinary `imsgcrawl sync` change from replacing the archive snapshot to retaining absent rows through merge semantics for existing v0.1 archives?
rationale: This is an intentional, user-visible upgrade contract change rather than a mechanical correctness choice; either behavior can be valid, but existing users can observe materially different retention outcomes after upgrading.

options.title: Keep replacement as the default
options.body: Retain current snapshot-replacement behavior for plain `sync` and expose archival merge retention only through an explicit opt-in mode.

options.title: Adopt merge by default
options.body: Approve the new retention contract, document the upgrade behavior prominently, and require evidence that existing archive workflows remain understandable and recoverable through `--restore`.

recommendation.title: Keep replacement as the default
recommendation.body: Retain current snapshot-replacement behavior for plain `sync` and expose archival merge retention only through an explicit opt-in mode.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history connects this contributor directly to the proposed archive contract and implementation.
